finding: A failed payable call credited 1 simulated wei to this v1.0 contract despite rolled-back accounting. The wei is not recoverable through v1.0 withdraw. No actual demo claims were created. v1.0 was not connected to a public frontend or submitted as a milestone.
replacement: contrary.v1.1.0 separates nonpayable source preparation from payable funding and credits invalid payable values for withdrawal. The replacement requires its own fresh deployment and live proof.
